name: Bullet_Water
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent 2D cartoon WATER projectile sprite for a tower-defense game. Reference image is the game's wind projectile, STYLE ONLY. Draw one chunky bright aqua/cobalt WATER DROP with a short flowing liquid tail, facing RIGHT; circular rounded droplet nose at right, compact wave-like taper trail left. Thick clean teal-blue outline, three flat cyan blue shading tones and simple white water highlight. No wind-green palette, no ice shards, no snowflakes, no fire, no scenery, no text or frame. Center complete silhouette on square transparent canvas with generous clear margin. Minimal tiny water droplets only. True alpha background, read at 64px.
